A source reporting effective status only establishes what it reported at its own date. Empty evidence is valid; do not force a recovery.

While some sources report a 'preliminary affirmative determination' from July 2025, other sources cite a 'final affirmative determination' announced on February 11, 2026. The research date is September 9, 2026, which makes the preliminary status outdated and the final status potentially unverified or conflicting depending on the specific source's reporting date versus the actual effective law. Additionally, one document was inaccessible, preventing a complete verification of the final scope or any rev
parsed.remaining_gap: It remains unverified whether the February 11, 2026 final determination is the sole effective law or if subsequent administrative reviews have altered the rates, as the full text of the final order's implementation details for specific companies beyond the listed exporters is not fully accessible to confirm current applicability.
